archive.catalogue_description: Helloo, i been making this map a couple months ago and finally got it finish, it was fun to make and play it, hope you all like it and have a lot of fun trying to beat this map haha. Like the name suggest, it’s a tower inspired map (i try to do something simple and ended up making all this thing), it has a lobby, 6 floors and a rooftop, there’s one perk per bedroom (2 bedrooms per floor), souls to fill in the elevator zone, a couple of wonder weapons and a micro easter egg, have fun and try to survive. This map have: -Soulboxes – Custom Weapons (MW2, MW3, Bo1 y Bo2) – Wonder Weapons (Apothycon servant, Ray Gun MK3, Electric Staff) – PanzerSoldat – Rotating Doors – Bo1, Bo2 and Bo3 Perks – 3 hits system – Tranzit Zombies – Origins HUD – Power ups customs (Money Power Up y Pack and Punch Power Up – Door with key – Custom Player Model and Hands – Sprinters – Hug Fix and Bo1 knife – Buyable ending Credits: – Shippuden1592 (SoulBoxes, Ballistic Knife, Electric Staff, Apothycon Servant, Ray Gun MK3, Tranzit Zombies, Power up Money, Sprinters) – Ricko0z (Custom Weapons, MW2, MW3, Bo1 y Bo2) – BluntStuffy (PanzerSoldat) – DuaLVII (Rotating Doors) – Gympie6 (Perks of Bo1, Bo2 and Bo3) – TaXi (3 hits system) – ThunderFrosty (Several Tutorials, HUD bo2, help with scripts) – Buttkicker845 (Door With key) – Gogeta (Pack and Punch Power Up) – Luis1234 con su coca de 3 litros (Custom Player Model and Hands) – Steviewonder87 (Zombie Hug fix and bo1 knife) – SajeOne (Buyable Ending)

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it.
